generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery certificate can become stale when material files are written after the certified freeze while the old result package remains published.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat a published result-only certificate as permanently valid and continue changing material files without re-freezing the new material candidate.
trigger_signals: fresh head differs from certified material identity
parent relationship no longer matches the certified material
paths outside the result-only allowlist appear after certification
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Classify every post-certificate head transition; any material path or parent drift requires a new material freeze before terminal handoff.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: After a material freeze, any later material write invalidates the terminal certificate and requires final gates plus a new freeze.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Before audit readiness, compare a fresh remote head, its parent and changed paths with the certified material identity and result-only allowlist.

skill_changes.evidence: The installed delivery skill already mandates post-write-refreeze after any material write and forbids handoff-only recovery when an auditor requires refreeze.
The installed recovery classifier and terminal handoff guard compare material identity, current head, parent lineage and post-handoff changed paths.
